snippet.title: Creature Kitchen Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Described as "creepy-cozy", Creature Kitchen is a cooking simulator where you befriend local wildlife and feed them their favorite snacks. "There's a strange house to search, a forest to explore, and plenty of stomachs to fill." https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097300/Creature_Kitchen/ #cozygames #cozygamer #creepycute
